summary: Pool Hill, Rockport MA: municipal 40-ft wooden tower first operated 1931 and used until 1941; FFLOS-registered 2008; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed among former lookout sites and used until 1941; the register does not say whether the tower still stands, and no source describes the site today

Used until 1941; the register gives no reason for the end of use

notes_for_editor: One register entry; no staffing, fire, access or present-day sources found. Status is 'unknown', not 'gone': the register lists the site among former lookouts and gives 1941 as the end of use, but does not say the tower was removed. The 1941 end is coded 'other', not 'abandoned', because the register gives no reason. Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts Facebook posts describe Pool Hill's tower as municipal and town-maintained, but they would not open (search snippets only), so they are not cited. Brief kind 'unknown' corrected to tower. 40 ft converted to 12.2 m. Story says 'first operated' because no build date is given.
